summary: Iteration 8: notifications, order timeline, confirm/decline (app + email link) and colour-filter ranking. Backend 13/13 pytest pass (1 order placed: B10036; 3 real emails in total). Frontend: bell + unread badge on Hem/Varukorg/Profil and on Sortiment once the gender picker is done; notifications list -> /order/{id} timeline works (Skickad/Bekräftad/Nekad); badge goes down after reading (2 -> 1 -> 0); 'Visa tidslinje' and the 'Nekad' badge work; admin reply sheet has Neka/Bekräfta and checks for an empty message; Svart filter shows solid black first and the product opens with -9900 preselected. One functional bug: the Blå filter ranks/labels some products as 'Svart' first, because upstream solid 'Svart' colours have base ['Blå','Svart']. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: The colour score treats any colour whose name has no '/' as 'solid' if its base contains a selected colour. Blåkläder data has 8 'Svart' colours with base ['Blå','Svart'] (and 'Mellangrå' with ['Blå','Grå']). So the first Blå result is 14531847 (only 'Mörk marinblå/Svart' and 'Svart'), shown as a black card labelled 'Svart'. Fix: give the highest score to solid colours whose base is a subset of the selection (e.g. 3), then solid colours with extra bases (2), then combos. Apply the same change to the frontend pickColor (src/color-match.ts) so the card image/label agrees.

Admin 'new' notifications are only created after the email is sent. When the email fails (early return at server.py:589-593), admins get no in-app notification, even though these orders need attention most. Notify admins in both branches.
'unread' is counted only from the latest 100 items (to_list(100)). Use count_documents({user_id, read:false}). There is also no retention/cleanup of old notifications.

ui_bugs.issue: notification-bell is missing on the Sortiment tab while the first-time gender picker is shown (shop.tsx returns the picker view without the header bell). It appears after choosing Herr/Dam/Alla.
First card for Färg=Blå is 14531847, black image with label 'Svart' (see backend ranking issue).

issues: reply-sheet-close icon is 24x24 with hitSlop 8 (about 40px, under 44)
'Neka' emails the customer straight away with no confirm dialog, and has no loading spinner (only disabled)

Step testIDs come from the label (timeline-step-${label.toLowerCase()}), so orders with several replies get duplicate testIDs (e.g. B10031 has 4 replies) and 'väntar på bekräftelse' contains spaces. Use the index or key instead
Orders whose email failed ('Ej skickad') still show 'Väntar på bekräftelse' instead of a failed step

action_items: Colour ranking: score solid colours whose base is a subset of the selected colours above solid colours with extra bases (backend $map score and src/color-match.ts pickColor), so the Blå filter shows Marinblå/Mörk marinblå first and not 'Svart'
Show NotificationBell on the Sortiment gender-picker view too
Create admin notifications even when the order email fails
Compute notifications 'unread' with count_documents instead of from the first 100 items
Minor: unique timeline step testIDs; 44px close target on the reply sheet; optional confirm dialog for Neka
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 995 lines (>700); split into routers (orders/notifications/admin/reply pages)
Nested Pressables in OrderCard (timeline link and reply button inside the card Pressable) work on web; check on native that the card does not also toggle
GET /orders/{id} correctly scoped (owner or admin, others 404); confirm_token/sent_to excluded

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; Blå ranking label issue)

rca_of_issue: Blå ranking: scraper.py:56 builds colour 'base' from Blåkläder colour ids. Some solid-named colours ('Svart', 'Mellangrå') carry the 'Blå' id upstream. The score rule treats a name without '/' plus any base hit as score 2 (solid), so these outrank real Marinblå items with a lower sort_index. Reproduce: GET /api/products?filters={"Color":["Blå"]}&page_size=6, where the first item is 14531847 with colours ['Mörk marinblå/Svart','Svart'].
